what: Any CSM or Ops Head can act in any zone while that ZM is present
policyClause: CONTEXT.md Decision 15 backup cascade ZM->CSM->OH gated on role_unavailability
reproduced: role_unavailability = 0 rows (direct psql). csm@fsm.test + header X-Acting-As-Zone:2 -> GET /api/dashboard/zone-overview HTTP 200, ONLY zone 2 (South, ZM Alla Lokesh present). Same for zones 1 and 5. ops.head@fsm.test identical. zm.north + header zone 2 stayed clamped to zone 1 (the ZM half of the hypothesis FALSIFIED - a ZM cannot widen); wm@fsm.test 403 at the role guard. Zone 99 accepted -> 200 empty, no 400; zone abc -> NaN -> silently ignored, caller believes they are zoned but sees pan-India.

what: Acting-scope writes recorded as if the manager did them himself
policyClause: acted_as_role stamped on every acting action; two drop mechanisms - 11 controller literal nulls, plus 16 of 30 direct tx.auditLog.create sites that never mention the acting columns
reproduced: Paired proof in one session. audit_logs #34793: CSM with X-Acting-As-Zone:2 POST /api/tickets/f1978011-8112-4ad1-a44f-fbd8669d1ce7/auto-recovery-close -> 200, stored acted_as_role NULL + acting_zone NULL. audit_logs #34794: OH with X-Acting-As-Zone:3 GET /api/ops-explorer/meta -> stored acted_as_role OPERATIONS_HEAD + acting_zone 3. Whole ledger: 34,758 rows, acted_as_role non-null on exactly 1.

what: Backup-share report reads zero CSM backup in every zone
policyClause: Issue 27 AC#5 per-zone CSM backup share
reproduced: GET /api/reports/csm-approval-share as ops.head -> [] for the current month; ?month=2026-08 -> 5 zones, csmActions 0 and sharePct 0 in every one. WORSE than predicted: the numerator is empty because acting writes stamp null (AA-02), AND the denominator is fake - 30 of the 31 acting_zone rows in the whole ledger are BULK_UNASSIGN_ZONE, where bulk-unassign.service.ts:289,367 reuses acting_zone to mean the TARGET zone of the unassign. Two independent defects feed one number, so fixing AA-02 alone cannot make it right.

what: Login has no rate limit, no lockout, no attempt counter
policyClause: credential store is the single gate for all five roles
reproduced: 12 consecutive wrong-password POSTs to /api/auth/login for zm.north@fsm.test -> 12x 401 in 548ms total, latency flat 31-42ms with no backoff, then the correct password -> 200 immediately. No lockout, no throttle, no counter. Compounded by AA-10: none of the 12 failures left an audit row, so the attempt is also invisible.

what: Entering and leaving acting mode leaves no trace anywhere
policyClause: acting-scope enter/exit is a state transition with no ledger
reproduced: Live JWT claims are {user_id, role, zone_id, iat, exp} only - nothing about acting - so acting is purely a request header and there is no server-side state for an exit to revoke. SELECT over audit_logs for any action matching ACTING/SESSION/LOGIN/LOGOUT -> 0 rows out of 34,758. Any tab, script or replayed request carrying a valid token plus the header re-enters acting scope; the access token also keeps working ~15min after logout (stateless, no revocation list).

what: No audit row for login, logout or failed sign-in
policyClause: static.md: 0 of 6 auth endpoints write an audit row
reproduced: After 12 failed and several successful logins, one refresh rotation, one refresh replay rejection and one logout, audit_logs gained ZERO auth rows; SELECT DISTINCT action matching ACTING/LOGIN/LOGOUT/AUTH/SESSION over all 34,758 rows returns nothing.

what: Acting narrows five read screens; every write stays pan-India
policyClause: CONTEXT.md Decision 15 - acting means standing in for that zone ZM, so the acting zone must bound reads AND writes
reproduced: Only 5 controllers inject @CurrentScope (dashboard, reports, batches, dispatch-today, schedules). GET /api/tickets as CSM returned the same 100 rows spanning zones 1-5 with the header, without it, and with a different zone - the primary manager list never narrows; GET /api/dispatch-runs and the GET /schedules list (line 523) likewise unchanged. Worse on the write side: writes take scope from @CurrentUser, so a CSM acting in zone 2 closed a ZONE 1 ticket (audit_logs #34793) with no clamp and no error. Acting today gives a narrower dashboard and an unchanged, unbounded write surface.
